veranderings.rede: 'in die tyd van' is wordy; 'van ... tot' carries the same date range more naturally.
The past participle belongs at the end of the main clause, before the relative clause, in natural Afrikaans word order.

veranderings.blok: Klipmure by die koning se woonplek
veranderings.rede: The adverb 'daarbo' (up there) is written as one word.

veranderings.voor: By Mapungubwe kon 'n mens die mag
veranderings.na: By Mapungubwe kon jy die mag
veranderings.rede: The next sentence addresses the reader as 'jy', so using 'jy' here too keeps the pronoun consistent across the two sentences.

veranderings.na: wat tot vandag toe oorgebly het
veranderings.rede: 'tot vandag toe oorgebly' is the idiomatic way to say something has survived until now.
With an abstract noun such as 'leierskap', 'waarby' is more correct than the place word 'waar'.
